NOTES:
- The one mypy error is `work_items.py:934`, which imports the not-yet-written `workflow_moves`. That file belongs to another task (WP1-T3), not mine. My files add no mypy errors.
- `role_restricted` is my reading of the spec. A viewer whose role lacks `TEAM_WRITE_MEMORY` gets it on every move that has a transition. Sign-off role limits (`signoff_roles`) apply only to `eligible_to_sign`, so a plain member can still propose a move that only admins sign.
- When more than one `blocked_reason` applies, the order is `no_transition`, then `role_restricted`, then `awaiting N sign-offs`, then `reason_required`.
- `compute_item_moves` lists every other stage of the item's workflow. It uses `current_stage`, or `status` for legacy items. For legacy items with no active workflow it calls `materialise_legacy_workflow`, which writes a row.
- `PendingSignoff.role_restricted` is True when the transition sets `signoff_roles`.
- `tenant_id` is the data tenant, and the viewer or signatory is passed separately, so the tests open `tenant_tx` as the item owner.
